metadata.title: An approximate inner ball condition characterizing $C^{1,α}$ convex bodies
metadata.abstract: The main result of this paper uses an approximate inner ball condition to characterize $C^{1,\alpha}$ convex bodies for $0<\alpha\leq 1$. In particular, we show that a convex body $K$ is of class $C^{1,\alpha}$ if and only if there exist constants $C,\varepsilon_0>0$ such that for every $0<\varepsilon\leq\varepsilon_0$ and for every $x\in\partial K$ there exists $h^\varepsilon(x)$ satisfying $B(h^\varepsilon(x), C\varepsilon^\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha})\subset K$ and $\operatorname{dist}(x,B(h^\varepsilon(x), C\varepsilon^\frac{1-\alpha}{1+\alpha}))\leq\varepsilon.$ We then give a new proof of the regularity of the convex envelope by showing that $\operatorname{conv}(f)\in C^{1,\alpha}_{\rm loc}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ whenever $f\in C^{1,\alpha}_{\rm loc}(\mathbb{R}^n)$ and $f$ satisfies the coercivity condition $f(x)\to\infty$ as $|x|\to\infty$. Finally, we use the approximate inner ball characterization of $C^{1,\alpha}$ convex bodies to prove that the Minkowski sum of a $C^{1,\alpha}$ convex body and a nonempty closed convex set is a $C^{1,\alpha}$ convex domain.

analysis.workSummary: 对 0<α≤1，作者以近似内球条件刻画 C^(1,α) 凸体：对每个边界点 x 及充分小 ε，有半径 C ε^((1−α)/(1+α)) 的内球，其与 x 的距离至多 ε。由此给出强制性 C^(1,α)_loc 函数之凸包络保持局部 C^(1,α) 正则性的新证明，并证明同正则凸体与非空闭凸集的 Minkowski 和仍为同正则凸域。
techniques: 近似内球与边界 Hölder 正则性
analysis.breakthrough: 用统一的尺度化内球条件同时解释凸包络和 Minkowski 加法的正则性保持；α=1 端点对应半径不随 ε 缩小的情形。
analysis.limitations: 常数 C、ε₀ 必须对所有边界点一致；不能把 C^(1,α) 简化为处处存在任意小内球。凸包络结论需要 f(x)→∞ 的强制性，Minkowski 和还允许结果为不有界凸域而非凸体。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
